stops.title: The fellowships
stops.caption: Every small group, and its type.
stops.speech: Fellowships lists every small group: K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds and the rest, with who leads it and when it meets.

stops.title: Filtering by type
stops.caption: Narrow it to the kind you want.
stops.speech: The chips along the top filter by type, and the dropdown narrows to one branch, which matters once there are a few dozen.

stops.title: Finding one on the map
stops.caption: The nearest group to a member.
stops.speech: Find on the map plots them geographically, which is how you answer the question people actually ask: which one is nearest me.
